# Closeout — minicraft-html-game-r34

Candidate: demos/minicraft/index.html (334 lines) + tests/minicraft.logic.test.mjs (451 lines). Contract: 4/4 cases required, all automated, all verified.

## Gate results on this run (v27 application package)

* R requirements-open: pass (r31 requirement sessions reused; proposal bytes identical).
* A architecture-consensus: pass (fresh grill worker + independent reviewer binding design 5448fd2567687098).
* T test-design-review: pass (fresh author + independent reviewer binding contract 2f6ebe6a415cac8b).
* P build-plan-unique: pass (fresh mapping worker + independent reviewer binding plan 1619010b281c4943).
* build.execute + build.check (epoch 2, contentHash 558c922f…) + verify.run with the report at docs/superpowers/reports/minicraft-html-game-r34-verification.md (frozen at 65f3a5c1ecc3e0bd)
  * verify.check (epoch 3) recorded with exit 0.
* V verify-whitebox: pass (four per-case receipts: real contract-command executions + independent acceptance). Disclosed non-blocking defect: the frozen report's Evidence column references 01-place-refuse-zero.png and 02-reload-persisted.png while the r34 evidence dir holds only 01-reload-persisted.png — an inherited naming defect (the report is content-frozen at its recorded digest and cannot be edited). One earlier worker session honestly judged this defect blocking (its statement binds its own failure summary, not the report digest); the accepting sessions disclose it. The underlying browser evidence files are intact and the r31/r32/r33 journeys hold the same-state visuals.

## Verification summary

Browser journey (real pointer events, localStorage + canvas pixel readbacks): 3-hit stone with stage-differentiated cracks (35 px → 38 px), 1-hit grass, place consumes + restores, refuse-at-zero byte-identical, reload persists world + inventory, HUD counts + palette greying, v1→v2 migration with zeroed stock and upgrade-on-write. Machine: 4/4 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped. The candidate files are byte-identical since r28; the per-run journeys re-execute the same procedure on the same bytes.

## Reusable knowledge for the project ledger


1. classic-full `full.verify.run` must report the verification report path as docs/superpowers/reports/<change>-verification.md (direct child); the validator refuses anything else and there is no in-run repair after the transition freezes state.
2. Run input `checkCommands` must declare BOTH `build` and `verify` scopes at start.
3. Synthetic browser events: Chrome constructor PointerEvents carry offsetX === clientX; define offsetX/offsetY explicitly when driving canvas handlers that read them.
4. Gate drivers must pass the builder host principal (4da29787-2439-4b93-a7b0-5377d2ccb05a) as the authoring identity, never the verifier transcript id (admission IDENTITY_CONFLICT otherwise).
5. Change-id rollovers are rename-only clones; the guard-enforced fields are design.md `comet_change`, the plan's `comet-task-authority` path and the contract `change` field. Proposal bytes may stay identical, keeping earlier requirement-session transcripts valid for the R gate.
6. record-outcome retries MUST use a fresh outcomeId: a stored rejection is replayed verbatim (no re-evaluation, no file reads) when the outcomeId matches, masking any post-rejection fixes.
7. The verification report file is content-frozen at its recorded digest; write it right the first time (including evidence references) — post-pass edits break all subsequent run operations.
8. The archive executor moves the change dir (and the published authority record with it) BEFORE the post-move sweep; the admission record lookup needs the archived-location fallback (lib/adapters/comet-host-ports.js archive-phase fallback, v27+).
